nodes.name: reorder_audit_modal.html
nodes.summary: Modal partial that displays the audit log of manual drag-and-drop reordering operations for visits and activities, showing old/new order-index sequences per entity.

nodes.name: roles_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial rendering the study roles table (with organization/person assignment and masking flags) plus an inline add-role form; swapped into #roles-section on create/update/delete.

nodes.name: rollback_audit_modal.html
nodes.summary: Modal partial showing the audit log of freeze-rollback operations, listing restored visit/activity/cell/concept counts per rollback event.

nodes.name: rules.html
nodes.summary: Full page for creating and managing study transition rules (name, label, description, rule text) with inline save/delete forms per row.

nodes.name: schedule_timelines.html
nodes.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the schedule timelines section partial as its sole content.

nodes.name: sdtm_specialization_detail.html
nodes.summary: Detail view for a single CDISC Library SDTM Dataset Specialization, rendering its variable table, summary key/value pairs, and raw JSON payload with error/missing-key diagnostics.

nodes.name: sdtm_specializations.html
nodes.summary: List view of CDISC Library SDTM dataset specializations with client-side search filtering, a refresh action, and links into per-item detail pages.

nodes.name: sdtm_specializations_status.html
nodes.summary: Diagnostics page showing cache status for the SDTM specializations fetch (count, fetch time, cache age, last error/URL, API key presence) and a raw sample payload.

nodes.name: sdtm_terminology.html
nodes.summary: Controlled terminology browser for SDTM, providing filter fields (search, code, codelist name/code, limit), a paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

nodes.name: soa_matrix_export.html
nodes.summary: Standalone, self-contained HTML document (not extending base.html) for print/export rendering of the full SoA matrix across schedule timelines, with embedded CSS and expandable concept/surrogate detail per activity.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds the shared stylesheet inline via {{ css }} and adds print-media overrides, since this template is served standalone for browser print/PDF export rather than through the normal base-layout chain.

nodes.name: study_cells.html
nodes.summary: Page for managing study cells (arm + epoch + element junctions), with a creation form and a reorderable table supporting row move-up/down and a persisted custom order.

nodes.name: study_identifiers_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial listing study identifiers (e.g. NCT numbers) with delete actions, and an add-identifier form with an organization scope selector.

nodes.name: study_interventions.html
nodes.summary: Page for creating study interventions (name, label, description, role/type/duration codes) that includes the interventions partial to render the existing list.

nodes.name: study_interventions_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial rendering the study interventions table with role/type/duration columns, delete actions, and a nested per-intervention codes sub-table with its own add-code form.

nodes.name: study_timing.html
nodes.summary: Composite study-timing dashboard page assembling five collapsible sections (schedule timelines, scheduled activity instances, scheduled decision instances, condition assignments, timings) via includes, with collapse-state persisted in localStorage.

nodes.name: study_titles_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial listing study titles with type decode labels and delete actions, plus an add-title form with a type-code dropdown that syncs a hidden decode field.

nodes.name: tdd.html
nodes.summary: Page listing generatable SDTM Trial Design Domains with per-domain JSON/CSV download links and an in-page HTMX-driven preview action.

nodes.name: tdd_view_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial that renders a preview table of generated Trial Design Domain records for one domain, swapped into the #tdd-preview target with a close button.

nodes.name: timings.html
nodes.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the timings section partial as its sole content.

nodes.name: transition_rules_list.html
nodes.summary: Standalone HTMX partial rendering an ordered list of transition rules with inline save and delete forms per rule, swapped into #transition-rule-list.
